newsitem.title: USA: Praegitzer sees Q3 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Praegitzer sees Q3 earnings below estimates.

text.p: Praegitzer Industries Inc said Friday that revenue and earnings are expected to come in below analysts' estimates for its fiscal third quarter which ends March 31, despite the expectation of record sale.

The company said earnings would likely be a slight loss or breakeven, primarily as a result of higher than anticipated expenses associated with the startup costs of the new innerlayer expansion at the its Dallas facility and the expansion at its White City facility.
The company also attributed reduced earnings to costs incurred in integrating its acquisition of Trend Circuits and to a restructuring of its nationwide and international sales organization.

Quarterly revenues, although slightly lower than estimates, were still expected to be at record levels because of a strong backlog with a four week rolling average book-to-bill ratio of 1.20, said the company.
Praegitzer is a designer and fabricator of advanced printed circuit boards.
